(In the school literature clubroom…)

Monika: “Alright, that’s everything set up for the upcoming festival!”

Yuri: “I’m so excited for everyone to see our club’s display. I think it really showcases the literary talent we have here.”

Natsuki: “Yeah, and those cupcakes I made are going to be a hit, I just know it!”

Sayori: “I can’t wait to see all the different clubs’ displays. It’s always so much fun to see what everyone comes up with.”

Monika: “I’m proud of all the hard work we’ve put into this. Let’s make sure to really show off what the literature club is all about during the festival.”

Monika: “Thank you so much! We wanted to show that literature can inspire creativity in all forms.”

Art Club President: “Well, you’ve definitely succeeded. I can’t wait to see the reaction from everyone at the festival. Oh, and don’t mind the painting on my stomach - the others wanted to show how
sample.chosen:
Monika: “Thank you so much! We wanted to show that literature can inspire creativity in all forms.”

Art Club President: “Well, you’ve definitely succeeded. I can’t wait to see the reaction from everyone at the festival. Oh, and don’t mind the painting on my stomach - the others wanted to show how much they appreciate the collaboration between our clubs. In fact, we’ve been working on a mural that incorporates elements from some of the literature club’s favorite poems and stories. I think it will be a great addition to our display.”

Natsuki: “That sounds amazing! I can’t wait to see it.”

Sayori: “It’s a great example of how different clubs can come together and create something even more amazing than what we could do alone.”

Yuri: “Absolutely. It’s all about sharing ideas and supporting each other.”

Monika: “Exactly. And now that we’ve finished setting up, let’s go grab some snacks and enjoy the festival together. We can check out the art club’s mural and see how our displays complement each other.”

As they walk towards the snack table, the club members feel a sense of camaraderie and excitement for the upcoming event. They know that their hard work and collaboration will pay off, and they can’t wait to share their love of literature and art with the rest of the school.
